channel.title: Kimani Upshur Daily Devotional
channel.description: A fresh Bible devotional every day from Kimani Upshur, M.Ed.

item.title: Daily Devotional: Ephesians 6:11
item.description:
“Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.”

Ephesians 6:11 (KJV)

You have an enemy with schemes, but you also have armor. God does not send you into battle unprotected; He outfits you completely. Put on the whole armor today, not just part of it.

Prayer: Lord, clothe me in Your full armor today.

item.title: Daily Devotional: Romans 8:18
item.description:
“For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.”

Romans 8:18 (KJV)

Today's pain is real, but it's not the final word. The glory coming is so great that present suffering won't compare.

Prayer: Father, fix my eyes on the glory to be revealed in me.

item.title: Daily Devotional: Galatians 2:20
item.description:
“I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.”

Galatians 2:20 (KJV)

The Christian life isn't you trying harder — it's Christ living through you. Surrender, and let Him do what you can't.

Prayer: Jesus, live Your life through me today.

item.title: Daily Devotional: Proverbs 9:10
item.description:
“The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.”

Proverbs 9:10 (KJV)

Wisdom starts with taking God seriously. When He is big in your eyes, your choices get clearer. Begin today with reverence for Him, and wisdom will follow.

Prayer: Lord, teach me to honor You; that is where wisdom begins.

item.title: Daily Devotional: Acts 16:31
item.description:
“Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.”

Acts 16:31 (KJV)

Salvation is beautifully simple: believe on the Lord Jesus Christ. And God's promise reaches beyond you to your whole house.

Prayer: Lord Jesus, I believe on You; save me and my house.

item.title: Daily Devotional: 2 Corinthians 9:8
item.description:
“And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:”

2 Corinthians 9:8 (KJV)

God doesn't just give you enough — He gives you more than enough, so you can be generous. His grace overflows on purpose.

Prayer: Lord, let Your grace overflow through me.

item.title: Daily Devotional: John 15:13
item.description:
“Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.”

John 15:13 (KJV)

The greatest love is not felt; it is given, even at great cost. Jesus defined it and demonstrated it. Today, love someone in a way that costs you something small.

Prayer: Jesus, teach me to love sacrificially.
